The context timeout is hardcoded to 5 hours. While a longer timeout might be necessary for this job, hardcoding the value makes it inflexible. Consider making this configurable via a command-line flag, similar to how it's handled for `cricsheet-importer` in this PR. This allows operators to adjust the timeout without changing the code.
